title: Geometric regularity is invariant under compatible field and ring isomorphisms
statement: Let $k,k\prime$ be fields, let $A$ be a commutative $k$-algebra and $B$ a commutative $k\prime$-algebra. Suppose $\sigma:k\cong k\prime$ is a field isomorphism and $e:A\cong B$ a ring isomorphism satisfying $e(xa)=\sigma(x)e(a)$ for all $x\in k$ and $a\in A$. If $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $B$ is geometrically regular over $k\prime$. Here geometric regularity includes Noetherianity [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and regularity [def-weil-regular-scheme] after every finite purely inseparable field extension [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension].

source.place: Definition Tag 0382 (algebra-definition-geometrically-regular), using the finite purely inseparable condition (2) of Lemma Tag 0381 (algebra-lemma-geometrically-regular); transport argument in step 5 of lem-weil-pbc-regular-through-localization. Sources verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0382 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0381.

proof.text: Transport Noetherianity from A to B along e, using Mathlib isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv.

For a finite purely inseparable extension L/k\prime, put the k-algebra structure on L and B by composing their structure maps with sigma. Compatibility turns e into a k-algebra equivalence. The extension k\prime/k is finite by the surjectivity of sigma and purely inseparable because every element belongs to the image. Transitivity makes L/k finite and purely inseparable.

Finiteness makes L small in the universe max(u,w), where k and A live in universes u and w. Shrink L with its transported field and algebra structures is a finite purely inseparable extension tested by IsGeometricallyRegular k A. Apply that hypothesis and transport regularity through the tensor algebra equivalence induced by Shrink.algEquiv to obtain regularity of L tensor_k A. This handles independent universes, without imposing an extra smallness assumption.

Tensor e with the identity of L. The surjectivity of sigma makes the k\prime actions compatible on L tensor_k B: write each k\prime scalar as sigma(x) and use the usual tensor balancing relation. Algebra.TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul identifies L tensor_k B with L tensor_k\prime B. Compose these equivalences and use IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv. This proves all finite purely inseparable tests for B.
